Corbin Carroll lifts a two-run home run to right field to cut the deficit for the D-backs in the bottom of the 2nd inning
Video Transcript
Line drive headed for the corner.
And that ball is gone.
Carvin Carroll turned on that one, and they're right back on the board.
Well, he's been missing fastballs.
He hit that one 111 miles an hour.
His 22nd, and it's 5 to 2.
